entities.summary: John Gray was a British newspaper proprietor and economist. His first published work, A Lecture on Human Happiness, was broadly supportive of the ideas of Robert Owen, although he would later criticise Owen's communitarianism. Gray's critique of laissez-faire capitalism is usually associated with the school of Ricardian socialism and he was one of the earliest writers to advocate a centrally-planned economy. John Gray was a performers & entertainers from Scotland (1799, Scotland–1883-04-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
